description:
Kim Heesu has never once lost his title as the school’s top student. One day out of nowhere, a mysterious transfer student named Yun Seoju appears and steals that title away from him.

Ever since that incident, Heesu’s daily routine begins to fall apart. He tries to keep his distance, but for some reason, Seoju keeps approaching him while claiming he doesn’t want to be hated—making it impossibly hard for Heesu to push him away...

*“You hate me, don’t you, Heesu? ...I don’t think I want to be hated by you.”* *(Source: Polarfox, translated)*

**Original Novel:**  
[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/2093066438), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000080406), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=921022570)
